title: Bank ECS Bounce Penalty Shield (Salary Date Alignment)
hypothesis: Users experience unexpected bank penalties (₹450-₹590) when monthly SIP debit precedes delayed salary credits, prompting proactive mandate cancellations to stop recurring fines.
solution_direction: Salary-synced debit date picker, smart balance pre-check notification 24 hours prior, and automated auto-pause before bank bounce.

title: Flexible Emergency 'Smart Pause' vs Permanent Cancellation
hypothesis: First-time investors facing temporary liquidity crunches (medical, festivals, exams) cannot easily locate or configure a multi-month pause, defaulting to hard mandate cancellation.
solution_direction: Prominent 'Pause for 1-3 Months' flow placed right alongside cancellation, with calendar resume reminders.

title: First-Year Volatility Shock Absorber (Negative XIRR Reassurance)
hypothesis: Beginners who encounter negative returns or portfolio drawdowns in months 3-6 panic due to lack of compounding perspective and comparison to guaranteed bank FDs.
solution_direction: Contextual educational visualizer during market dips showing unit accumulation benefits ('rupee-cost averaging in action') without FOMO.

title: Student & Irregular Income Micro-SIP Adjuster
hypothesis: College students and gig workers with fluctuating cash inflows struggle with rigid fixed monthly commitment amounts, causing abandonment when allowances fluctuate.
solution_direction: Dynamic instalment flex (allowing user to temporarily drop from ₹1,000 to ₹500 for a month rather than stopping).
